headline: Shared Pools Spread Shocks. Isolated Credit Walls Them Off.

blocks.text: Shared Liquidity Pools: A single degraded asset triggers cascading fractures across unpartitioned chambers, spreading risk across the broader system.
Isolated Credit Accounts: Losses remain sealed within individual position bulkheads, halting contagion before it reaches adjacent reserves.

focal.reason: Directs focus to isolated credit architecture as the structural mechanism halting systemic failure.
